parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region where the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance resides. 

You can invoke [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) to obtain the region ID.

parameters.name: ServerId
parameters.description: The ID of the backend service instance.

parameters.name: ServerType
parameters.description:
The type of the backend service instance. Valid values: 

- **EcsInstance** (default): ECS instance.

- **SlbInstance**: load balancing instance.
